index.name: Li 1980
index.source: H. H. Li, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 9, 161 (1980), 293 K (refractiveindex.info main/BaF2/Li)

n2.source: typical literature value for light along [100]; reported values spread 1.8-2.9e-20 m^2/W; quoted from memory in the original code, not re-checked

kerrAnisotropy.source: sigma = (chi1111 - 3 chi1122) / chi1111; quoted from memory of Minkovski et al., Opt. Lett. 29, 2237 (2004) and Jullien et al., J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 22, 2635 (2005); not retrieved
kerrAnisotropy.uncertainty: unknown; check the papers. The Z-scan anisotropy paper of the Sheik-Bahae / Van Stryland group (CREOL publication 1820; a scanned PDF that could not be read here) gives BaF2 n2 along [100], [010], [110] at 532 and 1064 nm and a parameter u in chi(theta) = chi [1 + 2u (sin^4 theta - sin^2 theta)]; how u relates to sigma is still to be written down
